description: High-profile CVEs matched by service/product and version keywords. Bundled into the image; optionally refreshed when online.

cves.title: EternalBlue SMB Remote Code Execution

cves.title: SMBGhost Windows 10 SMBv3 RCE

cves.title: BlueKeep RDP Remote Code Execution

cves.title: PrintNightmare Windows Print Spooler RCE
cves.description: Print Spooler service remote code execution enabling LPE/RCE with system privileges.

cves.title: Heartbleed OpenSSL memory disclosure
cves.description: OpenSSL TLS heartbeat bug leaking servers' memory, including keys and credentials.

cves.title: EternalBlue SMB Remote Code Execution
cves.description: Windows SMBv1 heap buffer overflow allowing unauthorized remote code execution.

cves.title: ProFTPD 1.2.7-1.2.9 remote format string RCE
cves.description: Remote format string vulnerability in ProFTPD allowing root compromise.

cves.title: vsftpd 2.3.4 backdoor command execution

cves.title: PHP-CGI query string argument injection RCE

cves.title: Debian OpenSSL predictable keys
cves.description: Debian/Ubuntu OpenSSL generated predictable DSA/SSH host keys due to reduced entropy.

cves.title: OpenSSH user enumeration

cves.title: OpenSSH 2.2-7.7 username enumeration
cves.description: OpenSSH versions 2.2 through 7.7 allow username enumeration via malformed keyboard-interactive packets.

cves.title: PostgreSQL 9.6-13.5 read/write arbitrary files as superuser
cves.description: PostgreSQL <9.6.24, <13.5, <14 and <14.1 allows trusted attackers to read/write server files.

cves.title: PostgreSQL CREATE FUNCTION code execution
cves.description: PostgreSQL allows authenticated superuser to execute OS commands via CREATE FUNCTION with CVE-2019-16239.

cves.title: Webmin password_change.cgi command injection RCE
cves.description: Webmin <1.930 unauthenticated command injection via password_change.cgi enabling RCE.

cves.title: Drupalgeddon2 Drupal RCE
cves.description: Drupal 7/8 unauthenticated remote code execution via Form API.

cves.title: Apache Struts 2 Jakarta Multipart OGNL RCE
cves.description: Apache Struts 2 <2.3.32/<2.5.10.1 remote code execution via crafted Content-Type header.

cves.title: Log4Shell Log4j 2 JNDI RCE
cves.description: Log4j <2.15.0 JNDI injection enabling unauthenticated remote code execution via crafted log messages.

cves.title: Samba is_known_pipename RCE
cves.description: Samba <4.6.4 allows remote code execution via crafted SMB pipes.

cves.title: Zerologon Netlogon privilege escalation
cves.description: Netlogon authentication bypass allowing domain controller compromise.

cves.title: Citrix ADC/Gateway directory traversal RCE
cves.description: Citrix ADC/NetScaler <12.1-55.291 allows unauthenticated directory traversal leading to RCE.

cves.title: Citrix ADC/Gateway arbitrary file read
cves.description: Citrix ADC/NetScaler <12.1-55.291 allows unauthenticated arbitrary file read.

cves.title: Blaster MS03-026 DCOM RPC buffer overflow
cves.description: Windows DCOM RPC interface buffer overflow enabling remote code execution (MS03-026).

cves.title: PaperCut MF/NG authentication bypass RCE
cves.description: PaperCut MF/NG <22.0.10 unauthenticated auth bypass leading to remote code execution.

cves.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 path traversal + RCE
cves.description: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 path traversal vulnerability allowing file disclosure/RCE when combined with CGI.

cves.title: OpenSSH username enumeration

cves.description: Unauthenticated directory traversal in Grafana 8.0.0-beta1 through 8.3.0.

cves.title: Progress MOVEit Transfer SQLi to RCE

cves.title: F5 BIG-IP iControl REST auth bypass RCE

cves.title: Fortinet FortiOS out-of-bounds write pre-auth RCE

cves.title: VMware ESXi OpenSLP heap-overflow pre-auth RCE

cves.title: JBoss JMXInvokerServlet deserialization RCE
cves.description: Exposed JMXInvokerServlet endpoint allows unauthenticated deserialization RCE.

cves.description: Velocity template injection in Confluence Server prior to 6.6.12.

cves.title: Linux kernel Dirty COW privilege escalation
cves.description: Copy-on-write race in the kernel memory subsystem.

cves.title: Tomcat AJP Ghostcat file read / code inclusion
cves.description: AJP connector misconfiguration allows file read and JSP inclusion.

cves.title: Oracle WebLogic XMLDecoder deserialization RCE
cves.description: Deserialization of untrusted XML in the WebLogic WLS-WSAT component.

cves.title: F5 BIG-IP TMUI traffic-manager RCE
cves.description: Unauthenticated path traversal + command injection in the TMUI web interface.

cves.title: Pulse Secure SSL-VPN arbitrary file read
cves.description: Unauthenticated file read exposes sessions files / creds.

cves.title: VMware vSphere Client virtual SAN health check RCE
cves.description: RCE in vCenter Server / vSphere Client via vSAN health-check plugin.

cves.title: Confluence SSTI in user-macro / wiki markup
cves.description: Server-side template injection allows RCE in Confluence.

cves.title: ZoneMinder second-order SQL injection in getNearEvents (authenticated)
cves.description: web/ajax/status.php getNearEvents() concatenates the stored event Name/Cause into SQL. Entry via web/ajax/event.php rename/eventdetail (parameterized store, unsafe read). Affects 1.36.x before 1.36.38 and 1.38.x before 1.38.1. UNION exfiltration confirmed live on 1.36.35. No FILE primitives when secure_file_priv=NULL.

cves.title: Sudo host-option sudoers policy bypass
cves.description: Sudo stable 1.9.0-1.9.17 and legacy 1.8.8-1.8.32 evaluate the Host option against the invoking host, letting a sudoers entry for an unrelated host run commands locally. Fixed in 1.9.17p1.

cves.title: Sudo chroot (-R) local privilege escalation to root
cves.description: Sudo 1.9.14-1.9.17 resolves paths via chroot() on the user-supplied root dir while still evaluating sudoers, letting any local user run arbitrary commands as root. Fixed in 1.9.17p1; chroot feature deprecated.

cves.title: Kernel algif_aead LPE (Copy Fail)
cves.description: Linux kernel algif_aead in-place crypto flaw corrupts sensitive files for local root escalation. Affects 4.14-6.18.21 and 6.19-6.19.11; fixed in 6.18.22+/6.19.12+/7.0+. Actively exploited in the wild (CISA).
